name: Mexican Cabbage-Beef "Smash" Tacos with Cilantro Lime Crema & Fresh Salsa

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lime
½ small bunch cilantro
½ medium head napa cabbage

instructions.primary_message: Juice lime into a small bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lime juice (reserving a small handful for serving).
Add sour cream, water, and spices to the bowl, then whisk to combine the cilantro-lime crema. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup sour cream
¼ tsp cumin, ground
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Remove 8 outer leaves from the cabbage, dry them very well with paper towels, then cut each leaf in half crosswise to yield 16 pieces in total. Set halved cabbage leaves aside.
Peel and coarsely grate onion; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a medium bowl along with beef and spices. Using your hands, mix well to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small white onion
3 clove garlic
680 g lean ground beef
2 tbsp taco seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a spoon (or your fingers), spread a generous 1/8-cup of the meat mixture over the surface of each cabbage leaf half in an even layer, making sure to spread the meat to the edges. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, working in batches (and wiping the skillet clean between batches if needed), add cabbage, meat-side down. Cook, pressing down firmly with the bottom of a spatula halfway through cooking, until the meat is cooked through, about 3 minutes. Carefully flip cabbage and continue to cook until golden underneath, 1-2 minutes more. Transfer to a platter and loosely cover with aluminum foil to keep warm.
To serve, divide cabbage "tacos" between plates, then top with salsa, crema, and reserved cilantro. Enjoy!
